reports.title: Mantle Network (Token Migration) Audit (Quantstamp)
reports.description: Quantstamp audit (1 to 12 June 2023) with fix review of the L1MantleToken (MNT) and MantleTokenMigrator (BIT to MNT migration) contracts in mantle-token-contracts. The High finding MNT-1 (conversion ratio not guaranteed to be 1:1) was fixed in commit b187163; the other findings were Medium or lower.

reports.title: Mantle Token and Bridge Audit (OpenZeppelin)
reports.description: OpenZeppelin audit (6 to 13 June 2023) of the Mantle v1 L1MantleToken (MNT) and MantleTokenMigrator contracts in mantle-token-contracts and the forked L1/L2 StandardBridge contracts in the mantle repository, assuming the cross-domain messengers work as documented. No Critical, High or Medium issues were found; three Low and thirteen Note findings were reported, with fixes reviewed in individual pull request commits.

reports.title: Mantle Smart Contract Security Assessment (Zellic)
reports.description: Zellic assessment (7 to 9 June 2023) of L1MantleToken and MantleTokenMigrator in mantle-token-contracts and the forked L1/L2 StandardBridge contracts in the mantle repository. One High finding (3.1, initialize not guarded by the initializer modifier in L1StandardBridge) was fixed in commit a53dd95; the remaining findings were Low or Informational.

reports.title: Mantle Network (Bridge Contracts) Audit (Quantstamp)
reports.description: Quantstamp audit (2 to 16 June 2023) with fix review of the Mantle v1 L1StandardBridge and L2StandardBridge contracts (forked from Optimism afdd020) in the mantle repository; the cross-chain transport layer and bridged tokens were out of scope. The High finding MANB-1 (incompatible ERC-20 tokens can lock funds) was acknowledged, not fixed.

reports.title: Mantle Competitive Security Assessment
reports.description: Secure3 audit contest of the Mantle v1 monorepo mantlenetworkio/mantle at commit 3e2b6dbc (final commit c4a8fd85), covering the batch-submitter, bss-core, gas-oracle, l2geth, mt-batcher, mt-challenger, packages (L1/L2 contracts including bridges, StateCommitmentChain, TSS, fraud-proof Rollup and EigenDA/DataLayr contracts) and tss directories. It reported 14 Critical, 34 Medium, 35 Low and 57 Informational issues, of which 5 Critical were fixed.

reports.title: Mantle V2 Competitive Security Assessment (Secure3, March 2024)
reports.description: Secure3 private audit contest on Mantle V2 (Tectonic) covering the Mantle v1->v2 changes of mantle-v2 PR #72 (contracts-bedrock L1 and L2 directories plus the other changed contracts and offchain components) and of op-geth PR #20, at audit commits 00ce7b0 and be91998 with final commits 7040d02 and 64996df. It reports eight Critical findings, seven in the L1/L2 messengers, portal and ERC721 bridge (MNT-6 only acknowledged) and MNT-8 in op-geth core/state_transition.go.

reports.title: Mantle Node, Batcher, Proposer, and Tooling Incremental Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin incremental audit of the Go changes in mantle-v2 pull requests #72, #89 and #98 to op-node, op-batcher, op-proposer, op-chain-ops and op-service, mainly the Mantle DA integration, base fee and MNT native-token support. The scope is limited to offchain node, batcher, proposer and chain tooling software.

reports.title: Mantle OP-Geth Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin diff audit of Mantle's op-geth execution client fork (base 0a77db9 to head 4d05b2c), focusing on MNT as the native gas token, native meta-transaction sponsorship and the fee strategy (tokenRatio, BVM_ETH handling). The scope is limited to offchain execution-client software.

reports.title: Mantle V2 Solidity Contracts Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin audit of the Mantle V2 (OP Stack Bedrock fork with MNT as native token) L1 and L2 contracts in packages/contracts-bedrock at commit e29d360: bridges, messengers, OptimismPortal, L2OutputOracle, SystemConfig, BVM_ETH, GasPriceOracle and fee vaults, with a limited review of universal dependencies and a diff-only review of deployment, legacy and library files. Fixes are recorded per finding in pull requests #105 to #138.

reports.title: Mantle_V2_Public Competitive Security Assessment (Secure3, April 2024 edition)
reports.description: Earlier (April 18, 2024) edition of the Secure3 public audit contest on Mantle V2, scoping the whole mantle-v2 and op-geth repositories at audit versions 7040d02 and 64996df with final versions d8efd33 and 641584e. It reports five Critical findings, MNT-2, MNT-4 and MNT-5 in the contracts-bedrock messengers and ERC721 bridge and MNT-1 and MNT-3 in op-geth core/state_transition.go and core/vm/evm.go.

reports.title: Mantle_V2_Public Competitive Security Assessment (Secure3, May 2024 final edition)
reports.description: Final (May 10, 2024) edition of the Secure3 public audit contest on Mantle V2, scoping the whole mantle-v2 and op-geth repositories at audit versions 7040d02 and 64996df with final versions d8efd33 and 641584e, now listing declined submissions and several downgraded severities. It reports four Critical findings, MNT-4 in L1ERC721Bridge, the declined MNT-1 in the legacy v1 L1CrossDomainMessenger, the declined MNT-3 in op-chain-ops migration code and MNT-2 in op-geth core/state_transition.go.

reports.title: Code Review and Security Analysis Report for Mantle (MNT) Token Smart Contract
reports.description: Unsolicited EtherAuthority community audit, largely based on automated tools (Slither, Solhint, Remix), of the L1MantleToken.sol implementation taken from the verified Etherscan code at 0xcd368c1d80120b0dd92447c87eb570154f8e685c rather than from a git repository. It reports one very low severity issue and no repository revision, so no source coverage can be pinned.

reports.title: Mantle Op-geth & Op-stack Diff Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin diff audit (Everest, v1.1.1) of Mantle's EigenDA/blob data-availability changes in the mantle-v2 op-batcher, op-node and op-service Go code (c77cb6e vs fd99099) and of op-geth changes (4a20fa6 vs 87c2ac2, PR #93 RIP-7212 P256 precompile, PR #95 meta-transaction disabling). The scope is entirely offchain node, batcher and execution-client software (the only op-program file is a one-line constructor signature change), and no Critical or High findings were reported.

reports.title: Mantle Smart Contract Security Assessment (Euboea)
reports.description: Zenith (Code4rena) review of the diff in op-geth PR #103 at commit 3d54b513, which adds pre-confirmation transactions to the txpool and miner (preconf checker, deposit-log parsing). Despite its title the scope is entirely offchain execution-client (sequencer) code.

reports.title: Mantle Network Pre-Confirmation Transactions Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin audit of the op-geth changes between d28ec49 and 6a7275c plus follow-up PR #103 commits that implement pre-confirmation transactions in the txpool, miner, filters and RPC API. The scope is entirely offchain execution-client (sequencer) code.

reports.title: Mantle Network Security Assessment (Arsia)
reports.description: CertiK diff audit of the Mantle Arsia upgrade, which rebases Mantle on upstream OP Stack v1.16.3 and re-integrates Mantle features, covering listed files of mantle-v2 PR #290 (op-node, op-batcher, genesis tooling and the SystemConfig, GasPriceOracle, L1Block and OperatorFeeVault contracts), op-geth PR #148 (plus the tokenRatio fix PR #152), kona PR #19 and revm PR #20, with per-finding fix commits. One Major finding (MAN-31, latched blob-source flag in the op-node data source factory) was reported and resolved in 984e9ab.

reports.title: Mantle L2 Rollup Security Assessment (Sigma Prime)
reports.description: Sigma Prime time-boxed review of the Mantle v1 mantle repository at commit 3e2b6db, covering the Solidity contracts (TSS group manager and staking/slashing, EigenDA data-layer chain, predeploys, bridges) and the Go components (TSS, l2geth, mt-batcher, mt-challenger, fraud-proof, batch-submitter, proxyd and the datalayr-mantle submodule), with OpenZeppelin dependencies excluded. It reported 38 findings including 1 Critical and 5 High, with resolutions in follow-up pull requests and commits.

reports.title: Mantle L2 Rollup V2 Security Assessment Report
reports.description: Sigma Prime time-boxed review of Mantle V2: the contracts-bedrock L1 and L2 contract directories at commit 9d2f150, the op-node/op-batcher/op-proposer changes of mantle-v2 pull request #72 and the op-geth changes of pull request #20. The scope was extended to mantle-v2 pull requests #89, #95 and #98 (reviewed at e29d360) and op-geth pull requests #31 and #37 (reviewed at 4d05b2c).

reports.title: Mantle EigenDA Integration Security Assessment
reports.description: Sigma Prime time-boxed review (Everest) of mantle-v2 PRs #163, #184 and #185 and op-geth PRs #84, #93 and #95, covering Mantle's EigenDA integration in op-batcher, op-node and op-service, the RIP-7212 precompile and meta-transaction disabling. The scope is entirely offchain node, batcher and execution-client Go code.

reports.title: Security Review For Mantle (Collaborative Audit)
reports.description: Sherlock collaborative audit (July 2 - August 22, 2025) in two parts: the Pectra/Skadi upgrade change set in mantle-v2 (node, batcher, proposer, gas oracle, service code) and op-geth, and Mantle's OP Succinct validity-proof stack, i.e. the kona and op-succinct commit diffs, the whole hydro EigenDA repository and the op-revm BVM_ETH/fee changes in mantle-xyz/revm, each with a final fix commit; five High findings were reported (H-1 and H-2 in the mantle-v2 batcher/EigenDA client, H-3 to H-5 in op-revm deposit BVM_ETH handling), of which H-1 and H-3 were only acknowledged.
